criteria.note: A globe-type shut-off valve is fitted on a vertical pipe against a wall.
A round handwheel is clearly visible on the left of the valve.
The handwheel is heavily rusted, and there are some stains on the fittings; no active drips are visible.

assessment.fixSuggestion: Have a plumber inspect the rusted valve handwheel and consider replacing it before it seizes or starts to leak.
